# slugger

Turns titles into URL slugs.

Run the tests: `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`.

Run the tests with `./run_tests.sh`.

request: Hi, slugify should handle accented letters: turn `Café au lait` into `cafe-au-lait` by stripping the accents (standard library only) instead of dropping those letters.
